short_description: Benign skin tumors are non-cancerous growths that appear on the skin. They are usually harmless but should be monitored for changes.
temporary_advice: Monitor the size and appearance regularly
Avoid pressing or injuring the lump
Take pictures to track changes over time
avoid: Do not try to remove it yourself
risk_notes: Most benign tumors are harmless, but some skin growths may resemble more serious conditions. Monitoring is important.
when_to_see_doctor: If there is pain, bleeding, or ulceration
If you are unsure about the nature of the growth
